description: Turn supplied document evidence, raw operational text, OR a Host-LLM VisualSpec v0.1 JSON (`spec`) into a publication-ready workflow diagram with source references, clean vector SVG, Mermaid, Excalidraw scene, and interactive Studio deep link (`studioUrl`). THREE INPUT MODES: (1) HOST-LLM NATIVE MODE ($0 free, unlimited once signed in, <50ms — ALWAYS PREFER THIS WHEN YOU HAVE A HOST LLM): Construct `spec` (VisualSpec v0.1 JSON: `{schemaVersion:'0.1', kind:'flowchart', title, summary, sources:[{id,locator,excerpt}], nodes:[{id,label,role:'step'|'decision'|'concept',actor?,detail?,sourceIds:[...]}], edges:[{from,to,label?,sourceIds:[...]}]}` where outgoing edges from `decision` nodes MUST have a `label`) using your own LLM and pass `{ spec }`. Unseen deterministically validates citations, heals connectors, and renders SVG/Mermaid/Excalidraw/studioUrl at $0 Unseen credits even when server-AI credits are 0 (returning exact validation errors if anything needs self-correction). (2) RAW TEXT MODE (PAID / USES ALLOWANCE): Passing ONLY `{ text: '...' }` without `spec` uses Unseen's server-side AI pipeline and returns HTTP 402 if free monthly slots/credits are 0 — if that happens, switch to Mode 1 (`{ spec }`) for $0. (3) STRUCTURED SOURCES MODE (PAID / USES ALLOWANCE): Passing ONLY `{ sources: [{id, locator, excerpt}, ...] }` without `spec` uses Unseen's server-side AI pipeline (requires free monthly slot or credits). EDITING GUIDANCE: For cosmetic edits, edit `<svg>` XML directly. For structural edits, edit `spec` JSON and call `compile_workflow({ spec })` or `autofix_workflow({ spec })` ($0 free).

authToken.description: Optional session token (`utok_...`) obtained from `auth_verify_otp` or `auth_login` if not already supplied in the HTTP `Authorization: Bearer` header.

granularity.description: Target scope level: 'overview' for parent lifecycle summary (~8-12 steps), 'subprocess' when paired with focusSourceIds, or 'all'.

swimlane.description: Optional swimlane layout toggle (defaults to automatic swimlanes when 2+ actor groups exist)

evidenceCoverage.description: Optional document preflight coverage report from the host agent (`pagesExamined`, `totalPages`, `textExtracted`, `tablesExtracted`, `embeddedDiagramsDetected`, `omittedMedia`, `notes`). When omitted media or uninspected diagrams are reported, Unseen flags `EVIDENCE_NOT_INSPECTED`.

focusSourceIds.description: Optional subset of source IDs to focus on when compiling a specific subprocess or phase returned by detect_workflows.

hostContext.description: Optional advisory context observed by the host agent

includeExcalidraw.description: Explicitly include or omit inline Excalidraw scene JSON (defaults to true only for 'full').

includeSvg.description: Explicitly include or omit inline SVG XML (defaults to true for 'full' and 'svg', false for 'preview'/'compact'/'mermaid').

jobId.description: Optional job ID when resuming a workflow after clarification

maxPreviewHeight.description: Target preview height bound in px for responsive preview metadata (default 900).

maxPreviewWidth.description: Target preview width bound in px for responsive preview metadata (default 1200).

priorAnswers.description: Answers to prior Unseen clarification questions when resuming a compilation

answer.description: User's answer to the clarification question

renderFormat.description: Optional output size control (defaults to 'full'). Use 'preview' for compact metadata + svgUrl + mermaid without large inline Excalidraw/SVG blobs, or 'svg'/'mermaid' for a single format.

sources.description: Array of faithful source excerpts with locators from the input document (1..60 chunks, <=2000 chars each). Preserve exact thresholds, actors, and IF/ELSE branches.

spec.description: Optional Host-LLM pre-synthesized VisualSpec v0.1 JSON (`{schemaVersion:'0.1', kind:'flowchart', title, summary, sources, nodes, edges}`). When supplied, Unseen skips server-LLM generation ($0 credits, <50ms) and deterministically validates citations, heals connectors, and compiles SVG + Mermaid + Excalidraw + studioUrl.

text.description: Optional raw document or user text. If provided when `sources` is omitted or empty, Unseen automatically segments `text` into faithful `sources[]` chunks.

userGoal.description: The overarching operational goal or process description (defaults to `spec.title` or the first line of `text`/`sources` if omitted)
